framework: local four-derivative gravity with fakeon/purely-virtual quantization of the additional spin-2 mode
declared_domain: perturbative fakeon quantum gravity under the average-continuation/purely-virtual prescription, with the causality statement restricted to energies where the fakeon threshold is physically relevant
scope_guard: Do not convert perturbative unitarity into a causality PASS. The published fakeon construction explicitly predicts microscopic causality violation; a terminal RQIR disposition requires a normalized same-realization causal/time-response observable, its declared energy domain, and identical-domain comparators.
